delete.title: Delete account
delete.question: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{ accountName }}?
delete.consequences: Related imported or workflow data is removed only when it can be cleaned up safely. Deletion can be blocked by protected transaction data.
delete.protectedReferences: This account cannot be deleted because it is still referenced by protected transaction data. Resolve those references first.
delete.failed: This account could not be deleted. Try again.

financialAccount.name: Name

initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.DEBIT: Amount available when you started tracking this account. Negative values represent overdraft or a negative balance.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.CASH: Cash on hand when you started tracking. Negative values can represent an adjustment or negative cash position.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.CREDIT_CARD: Use a positive number if you owed money, or a negative number if you had credit in your favor. This is not your credit limit.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.INVESTMENT: Account value when you started tracking. Detailed investment valuation is deferred.

status.inactiveExplanation: This account is inactive. Its history and balance remain available, and existing work can finish, but it cannot be selected for new transactions, imports, or rules until it is reactivated.

configured.saveError: The account could not be saved. Review the account and credit-card details and try again.

financialAccount.creditDetailsMissing: Credit card details have not been configured yet.
